::: {.form-section}

### Select Data Type and Region

<div class="form-group">
  <label for="dataTypeSelect">Data Type</label>
  <select id="dataTypeSelect" class="form-control">
    <option value="" disabled selected>Select</option>
    <option value="Temporal">Temporal</option>
    <option value="Spatial">Spatial</option>
    <option value="National">National</option>
  </select>
</div>

<div class="form-group">
  <label for="regionSelect">Region</label>
  <select id="regionSelect" class="form-control">
    <option value="" disabled selected>Select</option>
    <option value="AFRO">AFRO</option>
    <option value="EMRO">EMRO</option>
    <option value="EURO">EURO</option>
    <option value="PAHO">PAHO</option>
    <option value="SEARO">SEARO</option>
    <option value="WPRO">WPRO</option>
  </select>
</div>

<div class="form-group">
  <label for="countrySelect">Country (Multi-select)</label>
  <select id="countrySelect" multiple class="form-control"></select>
</div>

<div class="form-group">
  <label for="startDate">Start Date</label>
  <input type="date" id="startDate" class="form-control">
</div>

<div class="form-group">
  <label for="endDate">End Date</label>
  <input type="date" id="endDate" class="form-control">
</div>

<button id="filterBtn" class="btn btn-primary mt-2">Preview Filtered Data</button>
<button id="downloadBtn" class="btn btn-success mt-2">Download Filtered CSV</button>

:::
